## Pull request overview

Fixes TypeScript build failures introduced in Phase 4 plugins by aligning plugin TS configs with the workspace defaults and applying small type/unused-parameter fixes across several plugin packages, plus wiring new plugins into the console app workspace deps.

**Changes:**
- Update `plugin-list` / `plugin-detail` TypeScript configuration to extend the repo root `tsconfig.json` and enable `react-jsx` builds.
- Resolve build-time TypeScript errors via import/re-export ordering, ref nullability typing, and unused-parameter handling.
- Add missing workspace dependencies for the console app (and lockfile) to include the new `plugin-list` and `plugin-detail` packages.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 10 out of 12 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| pnpm-lock.yaml | Adds workspace links for newly referenced plugin packages in the console app importer. |
| packages/plugin-list/tsconfig.json | Aligns TS config with repo root + JSX settings so the package builds consistently. |
| packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx | Renames an unused destructured prop binding to avoid unused warnings. |
| packages/plugin-kanban/src/index.tsx | Imports `ObjectKanban` before re-export/usage to fix scope/type errors. |
| packages/plugin-kanban/src/KanbanEnhanced.tsx | Updates `parentRef` typing to allow nullable refs. |
| packages/plugin-detail/tsconfig.json | Aligns TS config with repo root + JSX settings so the package builds consistently. |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx | Comments out incomplete inline edit mode call to fix build errors. |
| packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardRenderer.tsx | Uses a runtime `type` access workaround to satisfy TS where schema types don’t include shorthand widget fields. |
| packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardGridLayout.tsx | Same runtime `type` access workaround for shorthand widget mappings. |
| packages/plugin-chatbot/src/renderer.tsx | Marks unused `files` parameter to avoid unused-parameter errors. |
| apps/console/package.json | Adds missing workspace dependencies for `@object-ui/plugin-list` and `@object-ui/plugin-detail`. |
| .gitkeep-build-fixed | Adds an empty marker file (appears unrelated to the build fix). |
</details>


<details>
<summary>Files not reviewed (1)</summary>

* **pnpm-lock.yaml**: Language not supported
</details>

`handleEdit` no longer has a fallback when `schema.showEdit` is true but neither `onEdit` nor `schema.editUrl` is provided, so the Edit button becomes a no-op. Either implement inline edit mode state, or gate/disable rendering of the Edit button unless an edit action is actually available.

`useMemo` is being called inside `schema.widgets?.map(...)`, which violates the Rules of Hooks and can break when the widgets array length/order changes between renders. Refactor so memoization happens outside the loop (e.g., precompute derived schemas for all widgets with a single `useMemo`), or move per-widget logic into a child component that can safely use hooks.

The repeated `(widget as any).type` casts indicate a mismatch between the runtime widget shape and `DashboardWidgetSchema` (which currently requires `component` and has no `type`). This removes type safety and makes it easy to miss typos/unsupported widget kinds; prefer updating/augmenting the widget schema typing (e.g., allow a discriminated union for shorthand widgets) and use a type guard instead of `any` casting.

`const widgetType = (widget as any).type` relies on `any` to access a property that isn't in `DashboardWidgetSchema`, which weakens type checking throughout the shorthand mapping path. Consider widening/adjusting the widget type (or adding a local union/type guard) so `widgetType` can be accessed without `any` and the supported widget kinds are enforced by TypeScript.
